events.name: Bash
events.head: Test whether this run may send Apple Events to Terminal and show its parent processes
events.input: $ cd /tmp/e-cap; (osascript -e 'with timeout of 12 seconds' -e 'tell application "Terminal" to get name of front window' -e 'end timeout' 2>&1 & p=$!; sleep 15; kill $p 2>/dev/null); echo "--- parent chain"; p=$$; for i in 1 2 3 4 5 6; do ps -o pid=,ppid=,comm= -p $p; p=$(ps -o ppid= -p $p | tr -d ' '); [ "$p" -le 1 ] && break; done; pgrep -lx Terminal
